review.intent_summary: Use earlier seasonal matches and a training-fitted trend to distinguish unusual departures from ordinary repetition and growth.

criteria.criterion: A supplied season length selects earlier matching seasonal observations for the reference.

Automatic trend selection represents suitable linear and compound growth without flagging ordinary growth as point anomalies; automatic exponential selection requires consistent improvement on training-only chronological holdouts and otherwise retains a simpler trend.
The fitted trend remains frozen after training within a regime; later changed values do not rewrite that fit.
Callers can explicitly select none, linear, or exponential trend, and unsupported trend modes are rejected.

verification_evidence: Executed examples/growth_up.json and examples/compound.json through analyze: both completed with zero observations; selected linear and exponential respectively. Inspected compound confirmation: three chronological holdouts within training, exponential won all folds, and mean absolute error improved from 1.3808 to 0.4076.
